facts.fact: A World Bank restructuring paper records about 121 million NINs successfully generated as of 14 September 2026, out of about 145 million enrolments.
The World Bank paper says the 121 million NINs were generated following biometric and demographic validation and de-duplication.
The NIMS 2.0 contract for a MOSIP-based identity system was signed on 15 September 2026, with full operation expected by 15 December 2027, per the World Bank.
